purpose: Recorded control-API responses replayed by web/e2e/mock-control-api.mjs for the Playwright e2e and a11y projects (WEB_TESTS_S3.md 5.2).
generated_by: web/e2e/fixtures/generate.py: real scripts/web_api.py and scripts/web_runs_api.py responses over a temporary runs root built by tests/test_web_runs_s3.Fixture and tests/test_web_processing_s3.make_baseline_run (imported read-only)

workers.share_export (job_share_succeeded.json): real tool_api share_export worker with FFmpeg on a 2 s testsrc2 + 32.70 Hz sine clip
workers.share_export (failed, running, queued): web_jobs stub worker modes reject and sleep

admission_basis: job_types.json was recorded with the WebJobs test seam admitted_tools = all four job types, as tests/test_web_processing_s3 does for its walkthrough. job_types_product_default.json is the catalogue of an instance without the seam at commit 05a13f2; it reports apply_capture_profile as pending_root_admission.
normalisation: every job/art/src/rev/evd id, sha256, uuid, stub run id and timestamp is rewritten to a counter value in first-seen order over the files in name order; idempotency keys are fixed fixture-000000NN counter strings (chosen in advance under the lane rule that fixture keys stay low entropy; the lane recorded no scanner finding for any other key form, and no scanner allowlist was added). Stub run ids are named after the job that rendered them (RUN-STUB-DENOISE, RUN-STUB-AUTHORING, RUN-STUB-APPLY). Sizes, loudness and other numbers measured by the FFmpeg worker are kept as served and may differ between FFmpeg builds (not measured: one build was used). Four regenerations on one host on 2026-10-07 were each byte-identical to the committed set (41 of 41 files); no run-to-run variation is on record.
measurement_note: worker_checks, measurement.json and the layer documents describe synthetic signals only. The listening_acceptance value "accepted" in run_run_s3.json comes from the synthetic receipt written by the test builder (its scope sentence says so); it is not a listening result and supports no listening, tone, low-register or musical claim.
low_register_note: The synthetic clip and the mock-served WAV carry a 32.70 Hz sine (theoretical C1 of the nine-string tuning); no fixture implies a high-passed or notched signal, and the synthetic manifest records high_pass_applied false and hum_notches_applied false.
drift_check: tests/test_web_house_stack_s3.FixtureDrift regenerates into a temporary directory and compares the file set, ids.json, routes.json and the shape (keys and JSON types) of every file; exact equality is reported as a measurement.
